companionArt: a small well-worn corduroy teddy bear, warm honey-brown ribbed fabric, one patched paw in slightly darker thread, small black bead eyes, a soft flattened nose

pages.text: {childName} is not quite ready to sleep. Outside the window the sky has gone soft and dark, and somewhere far away, in the {setting}, {companion} is waiting.

{childName} climbs onto the soft velvet seat of the train. {companion} sits right beside {childName}, his corduroy fur feeling cozy and warm. Outside, the night sky is deep indigo. The train wheels hum a slow, rhythmic song. It sounds like a gentle lullaby for the {setting}. {childName} rests a head against the cool window glass. Everything is calm and still. The fields outside are vast and tranquil as they drift past in the moonlight. {childName} pulls a soft blanket up to a chin and watches the dim lights flicker.

The train sways from side to side, rocking {childName} and {companion} in a steady, soothing motion. The {setting} beyond the glass looks like a patchwork quilt of shadows and starlight. {companion} feels very soft against {childName}'s shoulder. A tiny station flashes by, silent and empty, with only one lantern glowing in the dark. The train moves slower now, feeling heavy and sleepy. {childName} breathes in the scent of cedar and clean night air. The world feels small, safe, and tucked away from everything else, cradled by the gentle rhythm.

The rhythmic clatter of the train tracks softens into a whisper. {childName} blinks slowly, watching the dark trees sway in the distance of the {setting}. {companion} rests quietly in {childName}'s lap, his stitched smile looking very serene. The train carriage is dim and quiet. A soft, amber glow fills the space. {childName}'s eyelids feel heavy like velvet curtains closing for the night. The motion is slower and deeper, rocking both {childName} and {companion} into a comfortable, sleepy haze where thoughts drift away like tiny clouds in the quiet moonlight.

Everything is quiet now. {childName} is tucked deep into the cushions with {companion} held tight. The train is just a gentle, rocking cradle moving through the dark. There is nothing left to do but rest. The {setting} is silent under a blanket of stars. {childName} feels very sleepy and warm. {companion} is resting, too. The train continues its slow, steady journey into the deepest part of the night. {childName} drifts into a dream, safe, peaceful, and perfectly still. The journey ends in soft, quiet sleep.

The train slows down even more as it passes through the dark heart of the {setting}. Each rhythmic click against the tracks is slower than the last. {childName} feels the heavy, pleasant weight of exhaustion pulling at sleepy limbs. {companion} rests against {childName}, his corduroy fur warm and familiar in the dim light. The world outside the window is a velvet blur of soft shadows and distant, twinkling stars. Everything feels slow, measured, and kind. {childName} closes eyes for a long moment, listening to the quiet, steady hum of the train.

A faint, amber light glows from a tiny station ahead, but the train barely whispers past it. The {setting} is sound asleep now, draped in a deep, peaceful dark. {childName} feels the gentle sway of the carriage rocking like a cradle. It is very easy to let go of the day. {companion} is perfectly still, soft and huggable. {childName} takes a slow, deep breath, feeling the air grow cooler and quieter. The steady, rocking motion is the only sound left, a soft heartbeat for the journey through the night.

There are no more lights flickering by outside. The {setting} is now a quiet blanket of starlight and soft shadows. {childName} feels very small and safe, tucked away in the cozy corner of the train. {companion} is nestled snugly against {childName}, sharing the warmth. Eyelids are almost completely closed, and the rhythm of the train has slowed to a soft, lingering pulse. Thoughts have faded away, leaving only the sensation of gentle rocking and the comfort of the soft blanket. Everything is still, dark, and perfectly calm for {childName}.

Deep, quiet rest fills the carriage. {childName} is drifting far away into a soft, dreamless space, held safe by the steady movement of the train. {companion} stays close, a constant, gentle presence in the darkness. The {setting} remains silent, waiting under the vast sky. Nothing moves except for the slow, rocking rhythm that keeps everything in perfect balance. {childName} is almost gone, tucked into the deepest, warmest part of the night. Sleep is here now, wrapping around {childName} like a soft, invisible blanket, peaceful and complete in the quiet stillness.

The train is a slow, steady pulse in the dark. {childName} feels the heavy warmth of the blanket wrapped close. Outside, the {setting} is a quiet sea of shadows, holding still under the velvet night. {companion} rests against {childName}’s arm, soft and steady. The rhythmic sway of the train carriage becomes a soft, humming lullaby. Every breath {childName} takes is slow and deep. The world is very small and very safe. Everything is just right for closing eyes and letting the gentle motion lead the way.

The lights inside the train are dim and soft. {childName} is tucked deep into the cushions, feeling held by the rocking train. {companion} stays right beside {childName}, a warm, familiar shape in the quiet. The {setting} outside is long gone into the dark, silent and still. There are no more sounds, only the slow sway of the train carriage. {childName} feels heavy and relaxed, like a soft leaf falling to the ground. It is time to let go of everything and drift into the dark.

Soft darkness fills every corner of the train. {childName} is quiet now, with eyes fully closed and breath slow and light. {companion} stays close in the stillness, held in {childName}’s gentle grip. The {setting} is silent, resting under the vast, deep sky. The train rocks one last time, smooth and slow, like a rocking chair in the night. {childName} is sound asleep, tucked away in a dream of stars and gentle motion. Peace is everywhere, deep and still, as the journey continues in quiet, dream-filled sleep.

beats.scene: sitting up in bed hugging {companion}, hearing a distant train whistle through the window
stepping aboard a small warm-lit night train at a tiny country platform, {companion} under one arm
INSIDE a cosy train carriage, sitting by a big window watching dark sleeping fields roll past, {companion} on the seat beside them, warm lamp overhead
asleep in the train carriage seat under a blanket, {companion} held close, the dark window and a small lamp behind them
